pre_outcome_basis: contracts/PAPER2_REAL_OUTCOME_EXECUTION_V1.json observation_timing sensitivity and Gate 2B date-overlap audit

exact_date.match: direct and image-based records within the same site x species x season with both dates known and absolute date difference = 0 days

within_14_days.match: direct and image-based records within the same site x species x season with both dates known and absolute date difference <= 14 days

offset_estimator: For every eligible direct-image record pair, compute log1p(image count)-log1p(direct count); the shared timing-matched offset is the unweighted mean across eligible pairs.
precision_recalibration: After fixing the timing-matched shared offset, re-estimate pooled within-season accuracy-group SDs from the full 2100-record cohort using the same 1 vs 2-5 structure.
refit: Refit the unchanged primary spatially adjusted V3 A+H+A:H model for ADPE/CHPE/GEPE using the timing-matched offset and recalibrated accuracy SDs.
reporting: species gamma_A, gamma_H, gamma_AH and crossover classification
inference: descriptive sensitivity only; primary 9999-permutation p-values are not recomputed or replaced
guardrails: The same-season primary offset remains the primary calibration regardless of which timing sensitivity looks more favorable.
No species-specific timing offset is introduced.
No unmatched records are dropped from the V3 process fit; matching is used only to estimate the shared offset.
